unit.can_do_en: Can introduce yourself, say where you are from, and ask the same.

situation_en: At a language café in a Helsinki library, Sara, who moved to Finland last month, talks with Leo, a volunteer. They say hello. Leo asks where Sara is from and where she lives now. Sara is from Spain and lives in Espoo. Then Sara asks Leo the same, once with a yes or no question (for example whether he lives in Helsinki). Leo is from Tampere and lives in Helsinki.

speakers.name: Leo
speakers.role_en: a volunteer who chats with newcomers at the language café

speakers.name: Sara
speakers.role_en: a newcomer who moved to Finland last month
